import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    for n in ['xl/workbook.xml', 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml']:
        print(f"===== {n} =====")
        print(z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))
        print()

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import OrderedDict

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

expenses = OrderedDict()
for row in root.iter(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
        ref = c.get('r')
        v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
        val = v.text if v is not None and v.text is not None else None
        cells[ref] = val
    cat = cells.get('A')
    amt = cells.get('C')
    if cat and amt is not None:
        try:
            expenses[cat] = expenses.get(cat, 0) + float(amt)
        except ValueError:
            pass

grand_total = 0.0
print("Expenses by category:")
for cat, tot in expenses.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {tot:,.2f}")
    grand_total += tot

print(f"\nTotal expenses across all categories: {grand_total:,.2f}")

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import OrderedDict

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

def cell_value(c):
    t = c.get('t')
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        is_el = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}is')
        if is_el is not None:
            return ''.join(tx.text or '' for tx in is_el.iter(f'{{{NS}}}t'))
        return None
    v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
    return v.text if v is not None else None

expenses = OrderedDict()
detail = []
for row in root.iter(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    cells = {c.get('r'): cell_value(c) for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c')}
    cat = cells.get('A')
    item = cells.get('B')
    amt = cells.get('C')
    if cat and amt is not None:
        try:
            val = float(amt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        detail.append((cat, item, val))
        expenses[cat] = expenses.get(cat, 0.0) + val

print("Expense line items:")
for cat, item, val in detail:
    print(f"  {cat:16s} | {item:16s} | {val:>10,.2f}")

print("\nExpenses by category:")
for cat, tot in expenses.items():
    print(f"  {cat:16s} | {tot:>10,.2f}")

grand_total = sum(expenses.values())
print(f"\nTotal expenses across all categories: {grand_total:,.2f}")
